rules.summary: Shares may not be offered or sold in the USA and US persons may not subscribe unless the board or management company decides otherwise. The definition is mixed: a residence-based list plus Reg S Rule 902, with a CFTC Rule 4.7 carve-out. US citizenship alone does not exclude, and US taxpayers who are not US persons may subscribe. FATCA is only a reporting obligation.

rules.summary: Jurisdiction/registration restriction: distribution, offering or investing is legal only where the shares are registered for public sale or where sale is not prohibited. Some funds or share classes available in certain jurisdictions may not be available in others.

citations.quote:
Who can invest in these funds
Distributing this prospectus, offering these shares for sale, or 
investing in these shares is legal only where the shares are 
registered for public sale or where sale is not prohibited by 
local law or regulation.

Also, some funds or share classes that are 
available in certain jurisdictions may not be available in others.

rules.summary: AML/KYC: investors must provide evidence of identity (and of beneficial owners), address and source of funds before account opening and on an ongoing basis. Account opening and transactions may be delayed or denied until satisfactory documents are received.

citations.quote:
Before opening an account and on an ongoing basis, investors 
will be required to provide documentary evidence of their 
identity (as well as the identities of any beneficial owners), 
their address, and the source of the funds to be invested.

We may delay or deny the opening of your account and any 
associated transaction requests and payments (including 
switches redemptions and transfers) until we receive, and 
judge to be satisfactory, all requested documents.

rules.summary: Discretionary rejection of applications in whole or in part; eligibility information may be requested where an owner is or may become ineligible; soft or hard closure may apply to new or existing investors.

citations.quote:
Rights We Reserve
Within the limits of law and the articles, we reserve the right to 
do any of the following at any time:
Reject or cancel any application to open an account or any 
request to subscribe for or transfer shares We can reject the 
entire amount or part of it.

Require shareholders to prove beneficial ownership of 
shares or eligibility to hold shares, or compel an ineligible 
shareholder to relinquish ownership If the directors of the 
management company believe that shares are being held in 
whole or in part by or for an owner who is, or appears likely to 
become, ineligible to own those shares, we can request certain 
information from the owner to establish eligibility or confirm 
beneficial ownership.

A closure may apply only to new investors (soft 
closure) or to further investments from existing shareholders as 
well (hard closure).

rules.summary: Market timing/excessive trading: requests believed to represent excessive trading or market timing may be rejected, suspended or cancelled.

citations.quote:
We may therefore take 
various measures to protect shareholder interests, including 
rejecting, suspending or cancelling any request we believe 
represents excessive trading or market timing.
